details:
## Description

Social Tab's status button and user search button background color always shown as black until cursor hover when using custom themes for example purple one.

## Reproduction Steps

- Use custom UI theme for example purple one.

- Re-open big menu.

- Go to Social tab.

- Look at the status button - (its black baground)

- Hover the status button. - (its now hovered state)

- Un-hover, move cursor to somewhere else. (It's now looks correctly with border color and background color purple as expected.)

## Details

- Category: User Interface

- Frequency: Always
